verdict.rationale: BugSnag's official bugsnag-js SDK automatically detects errors in the browser, Node.js and React Native, with plugins for React, Vue, Angular, Express, Restify and Koa. That covers web frontend, backend services and mobile in one first-party library. The docs cite error-reporting libraries for over 50 platforms and mention native iOS, Android and Flutter SDKs, and a hands-on user confirms the iOS SDK reports fatal errors automatically and took minutes to add. Missing for 10: first-party detail on automatic uncaught-error capture in native Android/iOS and non-JavaScript backend SDKs, and recent independent corroboration (the hands-on report is old).
